en: Google Play handles the monetary payment for Scanner Unlimited, a one-time non-consumable purchase, not a subscription. BALCO Converter does not receive or store payment-card or bank-account details. To grant, confirm, and restore Unlimited, the app uses the product ID (scanner_unlimited), purchase state, acknowledgement status, and purchase token received through Google Play Billing. The app stores the store-specific Unlimited entitlement locally. Purchase data is exchanged with Google Play; the app does not send it to a developer-operated server, Firebase Analytics, or Google Mobile Ads. If a successful Google Play ownership check no longer reports the purchase, the local entitlement is removed.

Апликација локално чува право Unlimited за конкретну продавницу. Подаци о куповини размењују се са Google Play-ом; апликација их не шаље на сервер програмера, у Firebase Analytics нити Google Mobile Ads.
